title: Mechanism-Based Intelligence: Differentiable Incentives for Rational Coordination and Equilibrium Alignment in Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2512.20688v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Autonomous multi-agent systems struggle with the Hayekian Information problem (using dispersed private knowledge) and the Hurwiczian Incentive problem (aligning local actions with global objectives). I introduce Mechanism-Based Intelligence (MBI), an architecture that treats intelligence as emergent from the coordination of specialized modules rather than a single monolithic model. At its core, the Differentiable Price Mechanism computes the exact gradient of the system loss as a price; subtracting its own marginal cost, each agent obtains the incentive signal   $$\mathbf{G}_i = - \frac{\partial \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{global}}}{\partial \mathbf{x}_i},$$   and the transfers take the Groves form. Each agent's best response minimizes the global loss given the actions of others, so the negative global loss is an exact potential for the resulting game, with a unique equilibrium at the global optimum. translated_title: 基于机制的智能：面向多智能体系统理性协调与均衡对齐的可微激励机制
translated_abstract: 自主多智能体系统一直受困于哈耶克信息问题（如何利用分散的私人知识）与赫维茨激励问题（如何将局部行动与全局目标对齐）。本文提出了基于机制的智能（MBI）架构，它将智能视为从专门化模块的协调中涌现而来，而非单一的整块模型。其核心是可微价格机制：将系统损失的精确梯度作为价格进行计算；每个智能体在减去自身的边际成本后，即可获得激励信号 $$\mathbf{G}_i = - \frac{\partial \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{global}}}{\partial \mathbf{x}_i}$$，而转移支付则采用Groves形式。在给定其他智能体行动的情况下，每个智能体的最优响应均能最小化全局损失，因此负的全局损失构成了该博弈的精确势函数，其唯一均衡点恰好位于全局最优处。基于梯度的博弈行为将收敛至……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出基于机制的智能（MBI）架构，通过可微价格机制将全局损失的精确梯度作为激励信号，使多智能体博弈成为以全局最优为唯一均衡的精确势博弈，从而同时解决哈耶克信息问题与赫维茨激励问题。
en_tdlr: Introduces Mechanism-Based Intelligence (MBI), where a differentiable price mechanism uses the exact gradient of the global loss as an incentive signal, turning multi-agent play into an exact potential game whose unique equilibrium coincides with the global optimum, thereby resolving both the Hayekian information problem and the Hurwiczian incentive problem.
